thread:
felix: heads-up — AWS partner called about apparent "hour boundary" skew vs marketplace billing. they batch per-UTC-hour but AWS marketplace expects region-local-hour buckets. customers seeing split-hour entitlements.

anna: ouch. do we have an example?

aws-partner: sample (sanitized): ```json
{
  "partner_id": "aws-xyz",
  "usage_start": "2026-03-28T01:00:00Z",
  "usage_end": "2026-03-28T02:00:00Z",
  "units": 120
}
```
We send hourly UTC; AWS marketplace is calculating in us-east-1 local wall-clock hour which on DST cutover shifts by 1h and causes 01:00-02:00Z windows to be split.

billing: that explains why invoice line items show two partial hours instead of single. on DST days the mapping between UTC hour and local hour is non-1:1.

eng: short-term detection: flag manifests where sum(units) for partner_hour != partner_provided_hour AND day is DST-transition. SQL probe: ```sql
SELECT p.partner_id, hr, sum(units) ledger_units, p.provided_units
FROM partner_hourly_agg l
JOIN partner_manifest_hours p ON l.manifest_uuid = p.manifest_uuid AND date_trunc('hour', l.hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = p.hour_utc
WHERE date_part('dst', p.hour_local) = 1 -- pseudo to find dst hours
GROUP BY p.partner_id, hr, p.provided_units
HAVING sum(units) <> p.provided_units;
```

felix: mitigation options: 1) accept partner-provided window_id that is already aligned to marketplace local hour (preferred), 2) translate UTC hours into marketplace region-local hours on ingest using partner-declared region header, 3) on DST days run special merge logic that collapses split windows where partner intent matches single-hour.

marketplace-bot: created PARTNER-3822: "AWS partner DST/hour-boundary reconciliation + ingest region-window header" assigned to eng. https://redwood.internal/partners/3822

eng: implement plan 2 + 1: require header X-Partner-Region or X-Usage-Window-ID. If X-Partner-Region present, we translate timestamps: window_local = date_trunc('hour', timestamp AT TIME ZONE partner_region) and aggregate accordingly. If window_id present, use as canonical dedupe key.

anna: partner comms: ask AWS partner to include X-Usage-Window-ID in manifests for the next 2 weeks around DST transitions and add note in onboarding that marketplace uses region-local hours. I'll draft notice.

aws-partner: we'll add X-Usage-Window-ID and region header. also switching exporter to include both UTC and local hour fields to make reconciliation deterministic. ETA 48h.

eng: reconciliation job idea: after ingest, run a collapse that groups any adjacent partial hours for DST days by (partner_id, customer_id, intended_local_hour) and sum units into canonical hour if partner-declared-intent exists. SQL sketch: ```sql
WITH parts AS (SELECT partner_id, customer_id, window_local, sum(units) s FROM partner_event_parts WHERE dst_transition = true GROUP BY 1,2,3)
INSERT INTO partner_hourly_agg (partner_id, customer_id, hour, units) SELECT partner_id, customer_id, window_local, s FROM parts WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM partner_hourly_agg WHERE partner_id=parts.partner_id AND hour=parts.window_local);
```
Mark originals as merged.

billing: test matrix: run against sample DST cutover days across regions (us-east-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1) and verify invoice line-items map to partner intent. Add integration tests under integration/partners/aws/dst-windowing.spec.ts.

felix: timeline? partner wants quick fix before next US DST date. can we ship detection+ingest-region header support by Wed and reconciliation job Fri?

eng: yes. region header translation + tests ~1.5d, reconciliation job another day. we'll prioritize.

anna: also note for legal/onboarding: update partner contract language to require X-Usage-Window-ID for non-standard windowing or region-local semantics.

aws-partner: thanks — will pause large replays until we include window_id. will provide signed manifests for past 3 DST dates to help reconcile.

felix: ok closing loop: standup tomorrow 9:15 PT to confirm PARTNER-3822. thanks all. :calendar:
